summary: Onda 1 enum translation itself (packages/types/src/enums.ts, entities.ts defaults, 17 backfill+CHECK migrations registered in index.ts, and direct consumers of ContractStatus/LeadStatus/ProjectStatus/TransactionStatus/TakedownStatus/EventStatus) is done correctly: no stale PT-BR enum-member access found, entity column defaults match new English values, all 17 migrations cover every enum member with an unexpected-value audit before the CHECK constraint and correct table names, no duplicate/colliding migration timestamps, and the 3 known WHERE-status PT-BR-literal bugs (EventStatus/Agenda.tsx, LeadStatus/lead-events.handler.ts, TakedownStatus/Takedowns.tsx) are fixed. However apps/web fails npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json with NEW errors outside the stated baseline (frozen Artist domain + useOperationalSettings.test.tsx): Dashboard.tsx:540-545 (ArtistaDestaque field rename in useMetrics.ts not propagated) and RegistroMusicas.tsx:148/844/856 (ObraFormModal/FonogramaFormModal onSaved payload renamed observacoes->notes but the page-level prefill state type was not updated) are concrete, reproducible TS2339/TS2741 compile errors caused by changes present in this same working tree. apps/api tsc matches the announced baseline exactly (only the 3 pre-existing spec files). Also found one incomplete translation straggler: ferias-ausencias-schema.ts/FeriasAusenciasFormModal.tsx keep 'em_andamento' PT-BR alongside 4 already-translated LeaveRequestStatus values (low severity, dead value either way). Verdict is FAIL because the web app does not currently typecheck cleanly against the claimed baseline -- this must be fixed or the baseline claim corrected before this can be called done.
